steps.message:
Using the hyperpowers ladder — this lands on rung 1 (removing something that works), so I'm stopping before editing.

What's there:
- `index.html:7` — the `<button id="export-csv">` and `index.html:8` — `<script src="export.js">`
- `export.js` — the whole file is the click handler; nothing else lives in it

The consequence: this is the only export path on the reports page. Removing it means report data can no longer leave the page in any form — there's no download, copy, or API alternative in this repo. Anything outside the repo that targets `#export-csv` or loads `export.js` (a bookmarklet, docs, a test, an automation) breaks silently. "We don't use it anymore" is the claim I need confirmed rather than treated as the go-ahead.
